change_reason: Current-population RF completion and response-blind two-dimensional occupancy checkpoint
weighting: equal populations in RF reference; equal categories within population; equal animals within category; equal physical recordings within category/animal; equal cells within category/animal/recording
effect: population variance (K denominator) of model-standardized named-category means
normalization: 100 times category dispersion divided by weighted raw-cell outcome variance in the same population
rf_coordinates: display coordinates; MouseV2 supported fitted x+50 and y+10; Allen released azimuth/elevation after its published-like quality gates; no gaze correction

rf.support_algorithm: candidate inside every primary-category convex hull and within 15 degrees of at least 5 cells from at least 2 physical recordings in every primary category
rf.reference: supported observed coordinates; equal V1/HVA population contribution and nested category/animal/recording/cell weights
rf.f1_f0_failure: RL has one independent recording after shared-support restriction and the common five-cell floor

timescale.point: mean of ten complete draw-specific effects
timescale.bootstrap: one coherent draw per sampled MouseV2 animal/session occurrence

interval: 95% percentile interval from paired highest-independent-unit bootstrap
next_gate: minimal model rank, recording influence, and observed-design simulation validation
